fields.statement: A session message is written under the folder the session runs in (its record's Dir, a verifier's or review check's checkout, when set; its Worktree otherwise), and the pointer stays relative to that folder.
fields.wording: the planner's choice between the two fixes the bug request names (write in the session's own working directory, or an absolute pointer), made in an autonomous plan run: an agent reading outside its working directory may be refused or prompted

fields.acceptance: New tests in internal/api/session_message_test.go and internal/api/session_ask_test.go set a session record's Dir to a separate checkout folder and show: session message (and its dry run's File) puts 0001.md under <Dir>/.rhiza/local/messages/<session>/ and nothing under the Worktree's folder, with the pointer naming .rhiza/local/messages/<session>/0001.md; Deliver writes the answer there too; a session with no Dir still writes under its Worktree. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestSessionMessage|TestDeliver|TestTypePointer' and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(session-message|describe-golden)' pass, describe-golden.txtar regenerated if the File description changes.
fields.statement: A message to a session that runs in a detached checkout (a verifier or review check, its record's Dir set) is written under that checkout's .rhiza/local/messages/<session>/, so the relative pointer names a file that exists where the session runs; this holds for rhiza session message, its dry run, and the arbiter's answers that Deliver sends, through messageFolder in internal/api/session_message.go, whose File response description and doc comments stop saying the run's worktree.
